content: Vercel retired its own 'Vercel Postgres' product in Dec 2024, migrating it to Neon; Neon is now the default first-party Postgres option in the Vercel Marketplace, alongside Supabase. Neon: scale-to-zero, HTTP-based serverless driver (no persistent TCP connections needed - ideal for serverless functions), database branching for previews. Supabase: adds built-in auth/storage/realtime on top of Postgres but always-on compute (no scale-to-zero) and more product surface than needed here. For a small, single-brand app needing just Postgres + serverless-friendly connections, Neon is the leaner fit.
